name: Chuua Churam
source:
The idol who is currently the talk of the town...but in fact, she is the combined fusion of a human girl, Chiyu, and a vampire, Chuchu.

Chuchu is in control of the body and handles the singing, while Chiyu is in charge of talk shows and other activities.
